title: Task
description: One unit of work in the agent-tasks queue. Designed to map cleanly onto DB columns later (repo, stage, status, priority as indexed columns; payload/result/history as JSON columns).

id.description: Stable task id, also the filename stem. Format: YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS-<4 char suffix>, so plain `ls | sort` is chronological.

repo.description: Target repo name (matches a tasks/<repo>/ directory in this queue).

branch.description: Branch in the target repo this task works on, if applicable.

stage.description: Pipeline stage, e.g. implement | test | review. Agents claim by matching this field.

depends_on.description: Task ids that must be done before this one is eligible to claim (checked by claim-task.sh).

payload.description: Freeform input for whichever agent claims this stage (spec text, file paths, prior stage's result, etc.).

result.description: Freeform output written by complete-task.sh when the task finishes.
